title: Hard crash when removing a node that's a sibling from AnimationPlayer node with an animation
body:
### Tested versions

4.7 5cba18ff3bbe5adc9b4a8d7e970084979014b5f4

### System information

Windows 10 - Radeon RX 5900 - Ryzen 5 3600X

### Issue description

Godot crashes when removing a node from a scene with missing type nodes.

### Steps to reproduce

Download mrp, open scene, delete any node (I did with mesh instance and one of the missing classes. didnt test deleting camera, animation player).
